candidate_admission: all forward exact ordered state endpoints; keep shorter, equal and longer routes; enforce local peak; full budgets only during selection
deduplication: same start, end, expanded primitive route; retain all source families
greedy: same frozen DAG; replace current subpath only between surviving original-position vertices; require strict full-path length reduction and full resource feasibility; choose resulting length,work,peak,start,end,route lexicographically
dp: topological 3-dimensional Pareto labels; objective terminal length,work,peak lexicographic; ties first generated; guarantee only if label and transition caps unhit, within generated graph

external_rule_adapters.symbolic: rank exactly2 throughout exact old_moves occurrence -> new_moves
external_rule_adapters.frames: pure C common-frame B_h; nonempty I/M P; pure C common-frame B_g -> P; C_reduce(g h), fixed rank, nonempty h/g, strictly shorter; exact vendored peer enumerator

test_tuning: none after FREEZE; cumulative budget and explicit revision for any bug fix
